actions.mongodb_aggregate_documents.desc: Run an aggregation pipeline on a collection.
actions.mongodb_aggregate_documents.prop: Collection name, e.g. "users". Use List Collections to find it.
Database name. Defaults to the database in the connection. Use List Databases to find it.
Array of stages, e.g. [{"$match": {"status": "active"}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$category", "total": {"$sum": 1}}}]. Use {"$oid": "<24-hex id>"} for an ObjectId and {"$date": "<ISO date>"} for a date.
actions.mongodb_bulk_write.description: Run up to 500 single-document inserts, updates, replaces and deletes in one call.
actions.mongodb_bulk_write.props.collect: Collection name, e.g. "users". Use List Collections to find it.
actions.mongodb_bulk_write.props.databas: Database name. Defaults to the database in the connection. Use List Databases to find it.
actions.mongodb_bulk_write.props.operati: Array of operations, each an object with exactly one key: {"insertOne": {"document": {...}}}, {"updateOne": {"filter": {...}, "update": {"$set": {...}}, "upsert": true}}, {"replaceOne": {"filter": {...}, "replacement": {...}}} or {"deleteOne": {"filter": {...}}}. Use {"$oid": "<24-hex id>"} for an ObjectId and {"$date": "<ISO date>"} for a date.
actions.mongodb_bulk_write.props.ordered: true: run in order and stop at the first failure. false: run every operation and report all failures. Defaults to true.
actions.mongodb_count_documents.descript: Count the documents in a collection that match a filter.
actions.mongodb_count_documents.props.co: Collection name, e.g. "users". Use List Collections to find it.
actions.mongodb_count_documents.props.da: Database name. Defaults to the database in the connection. Use List Databases to find it.
actions.mongodb_count_documents.props.fi: MongoDB query object, e.g. {"status": "active"}. Use MongoDB Extended JSON for special types: {"$oid": "<24-hex id>"} for an ObjectId, {"$date": "<ISO date>"} for a date.

actions.mongodb_create_index.description: Create an index on a collection.
actions.mongodb_create_index.props.colle: Collection name, e.g. "users". Use List Collections to find it.
actions.mongodb_create_index.props.datab: Database name. Defaults to the database in the connection. Use List Databases to find it.
actions.mongodb_create_index.props.index: Name for the index. Defaults to a name MongoDB builds from the keys, e.g. "email_1".
Fields and direction, e.g. {"email": 1} or {"lastName": 1, "createdAt": -1}. Use "text" for a text index.
actions.mongodb_create_index.props.uniqu: Whether the indexed values must be unique. Defaults to false.

actions.mongodb_delete_documents.props.f: MongoDB query object, e.g. {"status": "active"}. Use MongoDB Extended JSON for special types: {"$oid": "<24-hex id>"} for an ObjectId, {"$date": "<ISO date>"} for a date.
actions.mongodb_delete_one_document.desc: Permanently delete the first document that matches a filter.

Database name. Defaults to the database in the connection. Use List Databases to find it.
MongoDB query object, e.g. {"status": "active"}. Use MongoDB Extended JSON for special types: {"$oid": "<24-hex id>"} for an ObjectId, {"$date": "<ISO date>"} for a date.
actions.mongodb_distinct_values.descript: Get the distinct values of a field across matching documents.
actions.mongodb_distinct_values.props.co: Collection name, e.g. "users". Use List Collections to find it.
actions.mongodb_distinct_values.props.da: Database name. Defaults to the database in the connection. Use List Databases to find it.
actions.mongodb_distinct_values.props.fi: Field path to read, e.g. "status" or "address.city".
MongoDB query object, e.g. {"status": "active"}. Use MongoDB Extended JSON for special types: {"$oid": "<24-hex id>"} for an ObjectId, {"$date": "<ISO date>"} for a date.
actions.mongodb_distinct_values.props.li: Maximum number of results to return (1-1000). Defaults to 100.

actions.mongodb_drop_index.props.databas: Database name. Defaults to the database in the connection. Use List Databases to find it.
actions.mongodb_drop_index.props.indexNa: Name of the index, e.g. "email_1". Use List Indexes to find it.
actions.mongodb_find_and_replace_documen: Replace the first document that matches a filter with a new document.
Collection name, e.g. "users". Use List Collections to find it.
Database name. Defaults to the database in the connection. Use List Databases to find it.
MongoDB query object, e.g. {"status": "active"}. Use MongoDB Extended JSON for special types: {"$oid": "<24-hex id>"} for an ObjectId, {"$date": "<ISO date>"} for a date.
The full new document, without update operators, e.g. {"name": "Ada", "status": "active"}.
Return the document as it was before or after the replacement. Defaults to after.
Insert a new document when nothing matches the filter. Defaults to false.
actions.mongodb_find_and_update_document: Update every document that matches a filter and return the updated documents.
Collection name, e.g. "users". Use List Collections to find it.
Database name. Defaults to the database in the connection. Use List Databases to find it.
MongoDB query object, e.g. {"status": "active"}. Use MongoDB Extended JSON for special types: {"$oid": "<24-hex id>"} for an ObjectId, {"$date": "<ISO date>"} for a date.
Return the documents after the update. Defaults to true.

MongoDB update operators, e.g. {"$set": {"status": "done"}, "$inc": {"views": 1}}. Use MongoDB Extended JSON for special types: {"$oid": "<24-hex id>"} for an ObjectId, {"$date": "<ISO date>"} for a date.
Insert a new document when nothing matches the filter. Defaults to false.

actions.mongodb_find_documents.props.lim: Maximum number of results to return (1-1000). Defaults to 100.
actions.mongodb_find_documents.props.pro: Fields to include or exclude, e.g. {"name": 1, "_id": 0}. Omit to return every field.
actions.mongodb_find_documents.props.ski: Number of matching documents to skip, for paging. Defaults to 0.
actions.mongodb_find_documents.props.sor: Sort order, 1 ascending and -1 descending, e.g. {"createdAt": -1}.
